name: McGinn: The Story So Far
overview:
From chasing a ball around the parks of Glasgow to taking on the best teams in Europe on the hallowed turf at Villa Park - McGinn: The Story So Far shines a light on the Scotsman's John McGinn career to date.

The Villa captain's journey to this point, where he has amassed over 300 appearances in claret and blue, has been an enthralling one, and his rise through the footballing world has been charted in our documentary, which is narrated by Andy Townsend.
